workflows.name: ABL & Inventory/AR-Pledge Financing Strategy, Facility Structuring & Bank-Relationship Governance

Automation Opportunity: - Facility-term-to-ledger comparison; covenant-calendar auto-build; bank-portal integration for availability; borrowing-base-vs-actual variance alerts
Controls: - CTL-740: facility approved by board/CFO; security perfected; covenant calendar maintained; bank-relationship concentration tracked
Cross-references: - links to VS-18.1 (W319 facility/covenant), VS-100.3 (legal/security docs), VS-105 (SCF supplier-side), VS-72 (multi-entity), VS-17.4 (FP&A); sets inputs for W4938–W4944
Pain Points / Risks: - **Concentration risk**: Over-reliance on one lender/facility → refinancing/withdrawal exposure; mitigated by relationship-concentration limits and syndication

- **Structural-mismatch risk**: Advance rates/eligibility that don't match BuildRight's actual inventory/AR mix (e.g., slow-moving import pipeline excluded) → chronic under-availability; mitigated by data-driven structuring (W4938)
- **Document-defect risk**: Security/pledge documents defective → unenforceable collateral; mitigated by Legal (VS-100.3) review and perfection (W4939/W4954)
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/debt facility module (VS-18.1 W319); contract/legal repository (VS-100.3); inventory ledger (VS-05); AR ledger (VS-16); FP&A (VS-17.4); bank portal/agent platform
Time Estimate: - ~10–16 weeks per origination/refinance; ~annual review 2–3 weeks; ~relationship governance continuous

steps.activity: Set the inventory/AR-pledge financing strategy: target facility size against ~PHP 5–7.5B inventory (per the 6–8x turns canon) + ~PHP 5B+ trade/ecommerce AR, the own-vs-syndicated decision, the ABL revolver vs TR-import-line vs warehouse-receipt mix, the advance-rate/eligibility expectations, the cost/utilization target, and the bank-relationship concentration limits

Structure the facility with the bank syndicate/Legal (VS-100.3): the borrowing-base definition, advance rates and reserves, eligibility/ineligibility criteria, reporting cadence, covenants (financial + reporting), events of default, cross-collateralization, the security documents (pledge/mortgage/trust-receipt framework under PD 115 + Civil Code), and the multi-entity (VS-72) guarantor structure

Govern the relationship post-close: the primary bank/agent relationship, annual review, the covenant calendar (W4944), RFP/refinance at term, and the integration with treasury operations (VS-18.1 W319 facility/covenant) and the SCF program (VS-105 supplier-side)

fields.Frequency: Per facility + on material profile change
fields.Participants: Finance (VS-17.4), Treasury (VS-18), Inventory/Supply Chain (VS-05/VS-02), AR (VS-16), Data/Analytics (VS-28)

workflows.name: Borrowing-Base Model, Advance-Rate Matrix & Eligibility Criteria Definition

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-eligibility testing from inventory/AR ledgers; advance-rate matrix engine; reserve auto-calc; availability-vs-history variance flagging
Controls: - CTL-740 (ensure controlled execution — Borrowing-Base, Collateral & Asset-Based Lending Facility Management (PA-170.1).)
- CTL-740: model reconciles to credit agreement; eligibility criteria documented; advance rates bank-confirmed; reserve basis documented
Cross-references: - links to VS-05/VS-29 (inventory/location), VS-16 (AR aging), VS-45 (consignment/VMI exclusion), W220 (SLOB), W91/W219 (quarantine), W4939 (certificate), W4940/W4941 (eligibility testing)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-eligibility risk**: Ineligible inventory/AR included → over-advance and true-down (W4943); mitigated by precise criteria + automated testing (W4940/W4941)
- **Reserve-understatement risk**: Reserves too low → overstated availability → over-draw; mitigated by data-driven reserve modeling and bank alignment
- **Profile-drift risk**: BuildRight's shift to imports/private label/B2B changes eligibility but model isn't refreshed; mitigated by change-triggered refresh
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/borrowing-base module (VS-18/VS-28); inventory ledger & category master (VS-05/VS-01/VS-29); AR aging (VS-16); FP&A (VS-17.4); analytics (VS-28)
Time Estimate: - ~3–4 weeks initial modeling; ~1–2 weeks per refresh

steps.activity: Define the borrowing-base model per the credit agreement: eligible inventory ( Finished goods, raw/intermediate, import-in-transit treatment) × advance rate (e.g., 50–70% retail, lower for slow-moving/seasonal/SLOB); eligible AR (domestic trade, B2B, ecommerce) × advance rate (e.g., 80–90% current); less reserves (ineligibles, concentrations, floor); and the resulting availability formula

Codify the eligibility/ineligibility criteria: eligible inventory excludes consignment/VMI (vendor-owned, VS-45), vendor-owned (W20), obsolete/SLOB (W220), damaged/quarantine (W91/W219), in-transit classification, and location eligibility (DC vs store vs in-transit); eligible AR excludes >90-day aged, related-party, COD-cash, disputed, foreign without LC/insurance, and concentration-over-limit

Configure the model in the treasury/ERP analytics (VS-28/VS-18): map inventory categories (VS-01 assortment), AR aging buckets (VS-16), location hierarchy (VS-29), and reserves; validate against historical availability; and document for the periodic certificate (W4939)

fields.Frequency: Monthly (+ weekly at elevated utilization per agreement)
fields.Trigger: Reporting cadence (monthly/weekly at higher utilization); period close (VS-17.1 W9A)
fields.Volume: 1 certificate per facility per period × 1–3 facilities

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-populate certificate from ledgers; eligibility auto-test; advance-rate engine; bank-portal submission; variance-vs-prior auto-flag
Controls: - CTL-740: certificate reconciles to GL/subledgers; eligibility auto-tested (W4940/W4941); officer-certified; submitted on time; bank queries logged
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.1 (W9A/W9 close & NRV), VS-16 (W81 AR allowances), VS-05 (inventory), VS-18 (treasury), W4938 (model), W4940/W4941 (eligibility), W4942 (availability)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Misstatement risk**: Certificate overstates availability (ineligibles included, stale data) → over-advance, bank breach, potential fraud; mitigated by automated eligibility testing + officer certification + recon to GL
- **Timeliness risk**: Late certificate → default/reporting covenant breach; mitigated by close-aligned cadence and automation
- **Representation risk**: Officer certifying inaccurate data → personal liability; mitigated by data-quality controls and review chain
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/borrowing-base module (VS-18); GL & subledgers (VS-17 W9/W9A); inventory (VS-05); AR (VS-16); bank portal/agent platform; document repository (VS-88)
Time Estimate: - ~3–5 business days per monthly certificate (aligned to close VS-17.1 W9A); ~1–2 days weekly

steps.activity: Prepare the borrowing-base certificate from period-close data: eligible inventory at cost (lower of cost/NRV per VS-17 W9) by category/location, eligible AR net of allowances (VS-16 W81), apply advance rates and reserves (W4938), compute availability, and reconcile to the GL and the inventory/AR subledgers

Review, certify & sign: finance review, the designated officer certification (representation of accuracy), the ineligibles/reserve schedule, and any required supporting detail (aging, location roll-forward); secure Legal sign-off on any representation language
Submit to the bank/agent, post to the bank portal, record the certificate in the facility file, and update availability monitoring (W4942); manage any bank follow-up questions and corrections

workflows.name: Eligible-Inventory Analysis, Locations & In-Stock Eligibility Testing

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-ineligibility flags from inventory status master; location-eligibility engine; shrink-adjustment auto-apply; GL tie-out auto-recon
Controls: - CTL-740 (ensure controlled execution — Borrowing-Base, Collateral & Asset-Based Lending Facility Management (PA-170.1).)
- CTL-740: eligibility auto-tested; reconciled to GL/cycle counts; shrink-adjusted; ineligibles documented
Cross-references: - links to VS-05/VS-29 (inventory/location), VS-45 (consignment exclusion), W91/W219 (quarantine), W220 (SLOB), VS-62 (samples), VS-05.1 (W6/W42 counts), W4939 (certificate), W4943 (field exam)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Ineligible-inclusion risk**: Consignment/quarantine/SLOB included → over-advance & true-down; mitigated by automated ineligibility testing
- **Shrink/accuracy risk**: Inventory over-stated vs physical → over-advance; mitigated by ≥97% accuracy target and cycle-count tie-out
- **In-transit classification risk**: In-transit mis-classified → availability error; mitigated by the status/location validation
System Touchpoints: - Inventory ledger & location master (VS-05/VS-29); cycle count/physical (VS-05.1 W6/W42); category master (VS-01); analytics (VS-28); treasury module (VS-18)
Time Estimate: - ~2–3 business days per cycle (automated); ~manual deep-dive on exceptions

steps.activity: Test inventory eligibility per the model (W4938): exclude vendor-owned/consignment/VMI (VS-45), damaged/quarantine (W91/W219), obsolete/SLOB (W220), aged/seasonal beyond limit, and samples/displays (VS-62); classify by category and advance rate; value at lower of cost/NRV (VS-17 W9)

Validate location & status eligibility: eligible only at approved DC/store locations (exclude in-transit unless eligible per agreement, exclude third-party/consignee-held), reconcile to the physical/ERP location hierarchy (VS-29), and flag location-status exceptions (closed stores VS-59, remodel VS-109)
steps.r: Inventory Finance / DC Ops / Store Ops / Analytics

steps.activity: Reconcile to the inventory ledger & cycle counts (VS-05.1 W6/W42): tie the eligible-inventory roll to the GL, apply shrink/accuracy (≥97% target), document reserves and ineligibles, and feed the certificate (W4939) and field-exam pack (W4943)

fields.Owner: ABL & Collateral Operations Manager / AR Finance
fields.Trigger: Each borrowing-base cycle (W4939); field exam (W4943); AR profile shift
fields.Volume: ~5,200 trade + ~200 corporate accounts + ecommerce AR tested per cycle

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-ineligibility flags from aging/credit status; concentration-limit engine; allowance auto-apply; GL tie-out auto-recon
Controls: - CTL-740 (ensure controlled execution — Borrowing-Base, Collateral & Asset-Based Lending Facility Management (PA-170.1).)
- CTL-740: eligibility auto-tested (aging/concentration/related-party); reconciled to AR subledger; allowances applied; ineligibles documented
Cross-references: - links to VS-16 (AR/aging/W81 allowances/W8 credit hold), VS-68 (trade credit risk), VS-72 (intercompany exclusion), VS-32 (returns reserve), W4938 (model), W4939 (certificate), W4942 (availability), W4943 (field exam)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-advance risk**: Aged/disputed/concentration AR included → overstated availability; mitigated by automated aging & concentration testing
- **Collection-cascade risk**: Collections reduce eligible AR faster than inventory rebuilds → availability whipsaw; mitigated by availability monitoring (W4942)
- **Credit-quality risk**: Eligible AR of deteriorated credit → true-down at field exam (W4943); mitigated by credit-cover (VS-68) and concentration limits
System Touchpoints: - AR subledger & aging (VS-16); credit-risk (VS-68/VS-16 W328); allowance (VS-16 W81); intercompany (VS-72); analytics (VS-28); treasury module (VS-18)
Time Estimate: - ~2–3 business days per cycle (automated); ~manual deep-dive on exceptions

steps.activity: Test AR eligibility per the model (W4938): include domestic trade/corporate current AR, exclude >aging-limit (e.g., >90 days), related-party/intercompany (VS-72), COD-cash, disputed/credit-held (VS-16 W8), foreign without LC/insurance/credit-cover (VS-68), and government receivables beyond limit; net of allowances (VS-16 W81) and returns/reserves (VS-32)

Apply concentration limits: per-account/concentration caps (e.g., top-account and single-industry limits), aggregate the eligible pool, and flag breaches for reserve/eligibility adjustment; reconcile to the AR aging (VS-16) and the trade-credit-risk view (VS-68)

Reconcile to the AR subledger & remittance (VS-16): tie eligible AR to the GL, document ineligibles/reserves, integrate with collections (which reduce eligible AR — links W4942 availability), and feed the certificate (W4939) and field-exam pack (W4943)

fields.Trigger: Daily/weekly treasury cycle (VS-18); certificate (W4939); funding need; collection inflow
fields.Volume: ~daily availability across 1–3 facilities; ~draws/repayments per working-capital cycle

workflows.name: Availability Calculation, Draws, Repayments & Excess-Availability Monitoring

Automation Opportunity: - Daily availability auto-calc; availability-first draw gate; auto-sweep of excess cash; threshold alerts; covenant-projection forecasting
Controls: - CTL-740: availability-first funding (no over-draw); daily availability reconciled to bank; covenant thresholds alerted; draws/repayments dual-approved
Cross-references: - links to VS-18.2 (W233 cash forecast), VS-15 (AP), VS-16 (collections), VS-19.2 (payroll), W232/W239 (import settlement), VS-142 (COD), W4939 (certificate), W4944 (covenants)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-draw risk**: Drawing above availability → immediate default and overdraft; mitigated by availability-first funding controls and automation
- **Covenant-breach risk**: Excess-availability or minimum-availability covenant breached; mitigated by threshold alerts and the funding plan (W233)
- **Float-inefficiency risk**: Idle excess cash not swept to repay → interest leakage; mitigated by auto-sweep
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/cash management (VS-18.2 W233 forecasting); bank portal/agent platform; AP (VS-15); AR/collections (VS-16); payroll (VS-19.2); COD (VS-142)

steps.activity: Calculate availability daily from the latest certificate (W4939) + collection/AR roll-forward + inventory movements: borrowing base − outstanding loans/letters − reserves = available; track against utilization, excess-availability covenant thresholds, and the minimum-availability covenant

Execute draws/repayments against availability: fund the cash need (vendor payments VS-15, import settlements W232/W239, payroll VS-19.2) via draw, and sweep excess cash (collections VS-16, COD VS-142) to repay; record against the facility and update availability

Monitor & alert: alert on availability thresholds (excess-availability covenant, minimum-availability covenant, approaching cap), reconcile draws/repayments to the bank, and escalate constraint to the funding plan (VS-18.2/W233) and SCF (VS-105)

fields.Owner: ABL & Collateral Operations Manager / Finance / Internal Audit (VS-21)
fields.Participants: Finance (VS-17), Treasury (VS-18), Inventory (VS-05), AR (VS-16), DC/Store Ops (VS-04/VS-07), Legal (VS-100), Internal Audit (VS-21)

workflows.name: Field Examination Coordination, Bank Audit Response & True-Down Management

Automation Opportunity: - Pre-exam self-test (run the bank's methodology on own data); AR auto-confirmation; discrepancy auto-flag; true-down impact modeling
Controls: - CTL-740: pre-exam self-test passed; inventory ≥97% accurate; AR reconciled; true-downs remediated and audited (VS-21)
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (audit), VS-04/VS-07 (DC/store site visits), VS-05/VS-16 (inventory/AR evidence), VS-100 (legal/dispute), W4939 (certificate), W4940/W4941 (eligibility), W4942 (availability impact)
Pain Points / Risks: - **True-down risk**: Exam reduces availability below operating need → liquidity crunch; mitigated by pre-exam self-testing and reserve buffer
- **Reconciliation-failure risk**: Inventory/AR cannot tie out → credibility loss and deeper exam; mitigated by ≥97% inventory accuracy and clean GL ties
- **Dispute risk**: Bank over-excludes eligible collateral; mitigated by documented eligibility and Legal (VS-100) engagement
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/borrowing-base module (VS-18); inventory (VS-05); AR (VS-16); GL (VS-17); document repository (VS-88); internal audit (VS-21)
Time Estimate: - ~3–6 weeks per exam (prep + on-site + report + remediation)

steps.activity: Coordinate the field exam: scope with the bank's examiner (inventory test-count at sampled DCs/stores, AR confirmation, eligibility/ineligible testing, advance-rate application, reserves), prepare the data pack (W4940/W4941 reconciliations, certificates, GL ties), and schedule site visits (VS-04/VS-07)
Support the exam & respond: provide inventory/AR evidence, reconcile discrepancies, confirm AR (customer confirmations), and respond to findings; manage disputed ineligibles/true-downs with the bank

Manage true-downs & remediation: if the exam reduces the borrowing base (ineligibles, over-statement, shrink), record the true-down, manage availability impact (W4942), remediate root cause (data, process, controls), and document for audit (VS-21) and the certificate (W4939)

workflows.name: Covenant Monitoring, Facility Reporting & Multi-Entity Governance

Automation Opportunity: - Covenant-calendar engine; headroom auto-projection; compliance-certificate auto-populate; multi-entity availability consolidation
Controls: - CTL-740: covenant calendar maintained; headroom monitored; compliance certificate officer-certified; intercompany sub-limits tracked; waivers documented
Cross-references: - links to VS-18.1 (W319 facility/covenant), VS-17.1 (W9A/W9B close), VS-72 (intercompany/multi-entity), VS-100 (legal/waivers), VS-21 (audit), W4937 (strategy), W4939 (certificate)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Covenant-breach risk**: A missed covenant → event of default; mitigated by the calendar, headroom alerts, and proactive waiver/amendment
- **Reporting-misstatement risk**: Inaccurate compliance certificate → default/fraud; mitigated by officer certification and audit (VS-21)
- **Entity-allocation risk**: Intercompany sub-limits breached → entity-level default; mitigated by the consolidated governance view
System Touchpoints: - Treasury/debt facility & covenant module (VS-18.1 W319); GL/consolidation (VS-17); intercompany (VS-72); legal repository (VS-100); analytics (VS-28)
Time Estimate: - ~quarterly covenant test 3–5 days; ~monthly reporting absorbed into close (VS-17.1); ~governance continuous

steps.activity: Monitor covenants per the calendar (W4937/W319): financial covenants (leverage, interest cover, minimum-availability, net-worth), reporting covenants (certificate cadence W4939, audited statements, compliance certificate), test against period results (VS-17.1 W9A/W9B), and alert on headroom/breach
Manage facility reporting: monthly/quarterly compliance certificate, borrowing-base certificate (W4939), financial statements, and ad-hoc bank requests; secure officer certification and Legal review

Govern multi-entity (VS-72): the cross-entity guarantor structure, intercompany sub-limit and downstream guarantees, the consolidated compliance view across the 5 entities, and the legal-entity-level facility allocation; manage waivers/amendments with the bank via Legal (VS-100)
